blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel’s final witness in Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth tagged the purchasing of a manager’s check as a form of “tinikling.” This was because the transaction was reportedly used to skirt a specific amount of funds from the year-end balance. The purchase was in reference to manager’s checks owned by Duterte and her father former President Rodrigo Duterte. The checks were sourced directly from Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) account jointly held by them way back 2016.
